_comment: Player-built paths (§11.8, §12.4), Phase 1 checkpoint 1g. All numbers are [TWEAK] placeholders. Costs are MODERN dollars per 10 m tile, multiplied by the era's price_multiplier (eras.json). Surfaces are listed in order of preference: new paths and paved desire paths use the last one unlocked in the current era (brick over concrete, §11.8; choosing a surface comes later).

route._comment: Dragging from A to B lays the cheapest route over buildable tiles (8-connected, no cutting corners past obstacles). Existing paths cost existing_path_cost per step, so routes join and follow them.

slant_walk._comment: §12.4: the first paved desire path that runs diagonally across campus and is long enough becomes the Slant Walk landmark (Heritage bonus recorded until the Heritage score exists).
